name: Lastlight Keeper Interior — Reference Gate A
review_note: Warm staggered floorboards, full pale curved walls, dresser, modeled wall lanterns, fitted windows, wall shelf, nested crockery and a corner cobweb reproduce the reference's sparse cozy keeper-room language while the owner-approved ladder replaces the spiral stair for cardinal movement.
verdict: PASS — materials, domestic purpose and room scale accepted
improve: The pictured character remains a runtime actor; preserve the slow lantern flicker and the readable domestic spacing.
